title: sdkGitConnection
description: Information about the SDK's Git connection to a Postman element.

repositoryUrl.description: The canonical URL of the target Git repository.

targetBranch.description: The branch the SDK is published to. This defaults to the `main` value.

pullRequests.description: A list of SDK update pull requests on the Git connection, in order of newest first by its `updatedAt` property. This returns an empty value if no pull requests have been opened yet. For full pull request details, use the GET `/sdk-git-connections/{sdkGitConnectionId}/pull-requests` endpoint.

createdAt.description: The date and time at which the Git connection was created.

updatedAt.description: The date and time at which the Git connection was last updated.

autoUpdatePullRequestsEnabled.description:
If true, pull requests are opened automatically whenever the source changes or a new version of the SDK generator is released. If false, pull requests are opened automatically, but only for manually-triggered SDK regeneration. If `autoUpdatePullRequestsEnabled` isn't set, the default behavior depends on the user's Postman plan:

- **Enterprise** plan users — Defaults to the `true` value.
- **Team** plan users and read only — Defaults to the `false` value.
autoUpdatePullRequestsEnabled.title: autoUpdatePullRequestsEnabled

workspaceId.description: The ID of the workspace that owns the SDK, derived from the source entity.

version.description: The generated SDK's semantic version ID. This value is automatically assigned by the release/changelog pipeline.

createdAt.description: The date and time at which the SDK was created.

updatedAt.description: The date and time at which the SDK was last updated.

sdkBuildStatus.description:
The SDK's build lifecycle:
- `queued` — Accepted but not yet started.
- `in_progress` — The SDK generation is running and in progress.
- `succeeded` — The archive is built and available for download.
- `failed` — The SDK generation failed. For information, check the `error` response.
sdkBuildStatus.title: sdkBuildStatus

sdkErrorBuildStatusFailure.description: Information about the SDK build's status when `buildStatus` is `failed`.
sdkErrorBuildStatusFailure.title: sdkErrorBuildStatusFailure

sdkGitConnectionPRStatus.description: The lifecycle status of a pull request.
sdkGitConnectionPRStatus.title: sdkGitConnectionPRStatus

sdkGitConnectionStatus.description:
The lifecycle status of the Git connection:
- `active` — The connection is live and all opened pull requests ship SDK updates into the repository.
- `disconnected` — The connection was explicitly disconnected by the owner, and no pull requests can be opened. The historical record is preserved.
- `inaccessible` — Access to the repository was revoked or its no longer reachable.
sdkGitConnectionStatus.title: sdkGitConnectionStatus

sdkLanguage.description: The target output language for the generated SDK.
sdkLanguage.title: sdkLanguage

sdkPullRequest.description: If the SDK was shipped (or proposed for shipping) through a Git connection, this is a compact representation of the pull request that shipped it. Otherwise, this returns a `null` value.
sdkPullRequest.title: sdkPullRequest

id.description: The ID of the Postman Collection or specification in Postman.

sdkSource.description: The collection or specification that the SDK is generated from.
sdkSource.title: sdkSource
